lineage.transform: Read-only rdflib harvest of first-party ~/dev repos (2026-08-02). Every *.ttl/*.owl/*.rdf/*.n3/*.jsonld under a canonical first-party repo is parsed with rdflib (turtle/n3/xml/json-ld) and one record emitted per graph file with triple/class/property/skos-concept counts, base IRI, owl:imports edges (blast-radius), a parses boolean, and a curation intent. Worktree/superset clones (*.wt, *-chronos-superset, *-kairos-draft, *-mesh-*), build mirrors (dist/, build/), and language envs (.venv, node_modules, site-packages) are skipped to avoid duplicates. Vendored EXTERNAL ontologies (SWEET, science-on-schema.org, environmental-exposure-ontology, gene-ontology obographs, BCO-DMO, KBpedia KKO) are recorded in third-party-vendored.jsonl at source-dir granularity and NOT ingested as ours. prophet-core-catalog's own derived SKOS turtle is excluded and cross-referenced to ds.topic-vocabulary (the topic-model-derived vocabulary), not re-ingested here.

checks: rdflib parse attempted on every graph; result recorded in 'parses' (348/360 parse; the 12 failures are enumerated in README as gaps, not hidden)
